focus: Claude Style Patch and README recommendations
keyQuestions: Which Style Patch rules are already covered?
Which rules are new or contradict punctuation and scope?
Which README adoption claims are compatible?
answeredQuestions: Most sentence and structure repairs are already covered
The absolute colon ban and universal installation scope conflict with the stack
Section-question transitions, dense-thread recheck, document thresholds and comment style are new

recommendation: Treat the style as binding and recheck it in dense or long threads
Use straightforward plain SVO prose, show mechanisms and preserve connective tissue
Ban every colon before a clause except a literal list of three or more
Lead with the point, use connectors and remove fragments or discourse announcements
Avoid stacked compression, nominalization and uncashed metaphors
Use bullets for parallelism and paragraphs for causality
Make each section answer an implied reader question
candidateOwner: a new repo rule or the wording standard

recommendation: Use Tractatus numbering only for complex hierarchy
candidateOwner: the wording standard or a new repo rule

recommendation: Keep response shape proportional and end without an empty closer
Ask only essential questions and correct directly
Allow natural color while banning honestly, load-bearing and crux
candidateOwner: the wording standard for authored output

recommendation: Make documents scannable in 30 seconds and nest only when hierarchy earns it
Use one idea per bullet, tables for parallel comparisons and key-value pairs for specs
candidateOwner: the wording standard or a new document-format repo rule

recommendation: Keep code comments concise, present-state oriented and visually spaced
Explain options before asking the user to choose
State concrete bans with repairs and examples rather than preferences
Install the patch globally or in project and system instructions
Recheck style explicitly before long prompts because compliance degrades on long threads
